event_description: A learner ran a search; captured server-side in the search route with the query and its length.
The streamed search response settled; records the grounded result count and how many courses it spans.
A learner clicked a search result card; records the result type (video or lesson), rank, and relevance.
The lesson video started playing for the first time, for any provider (YouTube, Vimeo, Bunny).
Playback crossed a 25/50/75/95 percent watch-depth milestone.
Emitted when the video unmounts, carrying the furthest percent and second reached in the session.
Playback passed 95 percent of the lesson video, marking the lesson complete.
The lesson page loaded at a specific second via a search jump or a shared deep link.
A learner opened a resource link in the lesson notes; records only the resource type.
The course catalog page rendered; funnel-top counterpart to course_viewed.
